title: ገጠር - Geter
logline: Growing up beside my brother in the green Ethiopian countryside, in a home that always had coffee and was never empty.
audience: Classmates and peers watching together in class, and Ethiopians who grew up in rural places and miss them
intent: Warmth, reflection and nostalgia: viewers who grew up in the countryside should feel their own childhood home again
style_block: hand-painted gouache illustration, lush green Ethiopian highland countryside, soft golden morning light, warm earthy palette, gentle film grain, faces simplified and stylised (not portraits), subject centred in frame

characters.description: TODO: you as a child of about ten - hair, clothing, build - in the exact same words every time
TODO: my brother as a child - hair, clothing, build - in the exact same words every time

voice.style: calm, warm, unhurried, like someone remembering their childhood home

shots.reason: Establish the place and its peace before any people appear
shots.image_prompt: green rural valley at dawn, flowering trees, thatched round houses, thin morning mist over the fields, birds in the sky
shots.motion_prompt: slow push-in, mist drifting, birds crossing the sky

narration.text: ያደግኩት ገጠር ነው። እዚያ እያንዳንዱ ጠዋት በወፎች ዝማሬ ይጀምር ነበር።
narration.subtitle_en: I grew up in the countryside. Every morning began with birdsong.

speech_metadata.style: soft and slow, like waking up

shots.reason: Sensory detail (scent, bees) to pull the viewer into the memory
shots.image_prompt: branch of a flowering tree in close-up, white and yellow blossoms, honey bees on the flowers, soft background blur
shots.motion_prompt: camera static, bees moving between blossoms, petals trembling in a light breeze

narration.text: አየሩ የአበባ መዓዛ ነበረው፤ የጫካ ንቦችም በአበቦቹ ላይ ያንጎራጉሩ ነበር።
narration.subtitle_en: The air smelled of flowers, and forest bees hummed over the blossoms.

shots.reason: Everyday village life: animals, work and the river that later shots return to
shots.image_prompt: cattle grazing in a green field, a donkey and a horse carrying loads on a dirt path, women washing clothes at a river bend in the distance
shots.motion_prompt: slow pan left to right, cattle grazing, river water flowing

narration.text: ከብቶች በመስኩ ይግጡ ነበር፤ አህዮችና ፈረሶች ጭነት ይሸከሙ ነበር፤ ከወንዙ ላይኛው ክፍል ደግሞ ሴቶች ልብስ ያጥቡ ነበር።
narration.subtitle_en: Cattle grazed in the fields, donkeys and horses carried loads, and upstream, women washed clothes.

shots.reason: Introduce my brother and the bond: a shared daily task, side by side
shots.image_prompt: two children seen from behind walking side by side on a grassy path toward a spring, each carrying a yellow water container
shots.motion_prompt: camera follows slowly behind them, grass moving in the wind

narration.text: እኔና ወንድሜ ውሃ ለመቅዳት አብረን ወደ ምንጩ እንሄድ ነበር።
narration.subtitle_en: My brother and I walked to the spring together to fetch water.

shots.reason: Play and joy: a lighter beat after the chores
shots.image_prompt: two children playing football in an open green field, a homemade ball, cows grazing nearby watching
shots.motion_prompt: camera static, the children run after the ball, a cow turns its head

narration.text: ከዚያም ከብቶቹ እያዩን በሜዳው ላይ ኳስ እንጫወት ነበር።
narration.subtitle_en: Then we played football in the open field, with the cattle watching us.

speech_metadata.style: a little lighter, with a hint of a smile

shots.reason: Freedom of the river; downstream answers the upstream image in s03
shots.image_prompt: children swimming and splashing in a shallow river, late afternoon light, trees along the banks
shots.motion_prompt: slow push-in, water splashing gently, light glittering on the river

narration.text: ከወንዙ ታችኛው ክፍል ደግሞ ፀሐይ እስክትጠልቅ ድረስ እንዋኝ ነበር።
narration.subtitle_en: And downstream, we swam in the river until the sun went down.

shots.reason: Holiday tradition shared with friends; the qetema carries us into the home
shots.image_prompt: children gathering bundles of fresh green qetema grass and tall grass in a meadow, holding the bundles in their arms
shots.motion_prompt: camera static, children lifting bundles of grass, grass swaying

narration.text: በዓል ሲደርስ ከጓደኞቻችን ጋር ቄጠማና ረጃጅም ሳር እንሰበስብ ነበር።
narration.subtitle_en: When a holiday came, we gathered qetema and tall grass with our friends.

shots.reason: Warmth of home: the qetema on the floor and the coffee ceremony
shots.image_prompt: traditional coffee ceremony on a floor covered with fresh green qetema grass, a black clay jebena on glowing charcoal, small cups on a tray
shots.motion_prompt: camera static, steam and incense smoke rising slowly

narration.text: ቤት ውስጥ ቄጠማ ተጎዝጉዞ፣ ቡናው ይፈላ ነበር።
narration.subtitle_en: At home, qetema was spread on the floor and the coffee was brewing.

shots.reason: The family proverb, given room to land: the film's central idea
shots.image_prompt: a small cup of coffee on a wooden tray, steam rising, soft window light
shots.motion_prompt: very slow push-in, steam curling upward

speech_metadata.style: slower, with quiet weight, as a well-known saying

shots.reason: Close on belonging: the same valley at dusk answers the opening and the proverb
shots.image_prompt: the same green rural valley at dusk, warm light in the round houses, smoke rising from a roof, flowering trees in silhouette
shots.motion_prompt: slow pull-back, smoke rising, light fading

narration.text: የእኛ ቤት ግን ባዶ ሆኖ አያውቅም። የእኔና የወንድሜ ሥር እዚያ ነው፤ ቤታችንም እዚያው ነው።
narration.subtitle_en: But our home was never empty. My brother's roots and mine are there, and so is our home.
